title: PawID evaluation on DogFaceNet (pet dog face photos)
caveat: DogFaceNet: aligned face crops of pet dogs (web photos). Not full-body photos of Indian community dogs in the field; no capture-session information, so same-session look-alike photos cannot be fully ruled out; small sample. Not evidence of street-dog accuracy.
command: cd ml && uv run pawid dfn-clean && uv run pawid dfn-split && uv run pawid dfn-eval

model.name: dinov2_small_arcface_head
model.detector: skipped — DogFaceNet images are already face crops
model.embedding: 384-d, L2-normalised (DINOv2 ViT-S/14 + projection head trained on DogFaceNet v1 train identities, which are excluded here)

selection_on_validation.criterion: max known-dog top-1 correct-and-confident rate with unknown-dog false-match rate ≤ 5%; tie-break top-1

metric_definitions.top1/top3: known-dog queries whose correct dog is ranked 1st / within the first 3 (closed set)
metric_definitions.map_image: mean average precision over gallery images (2 relevant images per known query)
metric_definitions.fpir: unknown-dog queries wrongly given a confident match (best score ≥ threshold)
metric_definitions.known_top1_correct_accepted: known-dog queries whose top-1 is the correct dog AND above the threshold
metric_definitions.false_rejection: known-dog queries answered 'no confident match' (best score < threshold)
metric_definitions.known_top1_wrong_accepted: known-dog queries confidently matched to the WRONG dog
metric_definitions.ci95: percentile bootstrap over identities, 1,000 resamples (known and unknown dogs resampled separately)

timing.single_image_includes: JPEG decode + preprocessing + ONNX inference, 4 threads
timing.search: exact cosine over 302 test gallery images, numpy
